summary: The factorial identity and both marked generating-function calculations preserve the original full-grid multiplicities and yield the stated formulas. Exact independent summation, grouped by k_0 and k_2 with the remaining three-coordinate multiplicities, reproduces all three sums, all three directional derivatives, the negative Schur product, and the positive value of P_0. Small full-grid instances, including zero and signed coefficients, also agree with the formulas. With a_0 fixed, the indicated transfer from coefficient a_2 to a_1 is a valid majorization-decreasing smoothing inside the strictly positive domain; its positive derivative therefore disproves Schur-convexity. No mathematical error or gap was found.
